data.one_liner: A drop-in replacement for Dart's DateTime class with const constructors.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ConstDateTime class that acts as a drop-in replacement for Dart's built-in DateTime class, adding support for const constructors. It allows creating date and time instances at compile-time and includes an extension to convert regular DateTime objects to ConstDateTime.
use_when: You need to instantiate DateTime objects in const contexts
You want to optimize performance by avoiding runtime allocations for constant dates
avoid_when: You only need standard runtime DateTime manipulation
You are looking for advanced date formatting or timezone handling libraries
strengths: Drop-in replacement for DateTime with identical API methods
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted entirely to mimicking DateTime with const support
